received_at: Date+time email received, DD/MM/YYYY HH:MM (Vietnam time)
source_email: Email subject line only. No links, no email IDs
company: Agency/OTA name exactly as in Ezfolio. If not in Ezfolio, write the name and put "new company" in missing_info
booking_ref: Agency/OTA booking or tour code. Same ref on every row of one booking
ezfolio_group_code: Required for CHANGE/CANCEL. Tracy fills it for NEW
confirmation_no: Ezfolio confirmation number. Required for CHANGE/CANCEL if known
what_changed: CHANGE only, e.g. "Dates 12–15 Nov → 13–16 Nov". CANCEL: reason
guest_names: All guests separated by ";" lead guest first, e.g. "MR VARUN; MRS PRIYA". TBA if not given
nationality: Country from email; if not stated, infer from names. Never leave blank
rooms: Number of rooms of this type
child_ages: Ages separated by ";" e.g. "9; 2". Blank if no children
rate_source: TA card / Anex contract / OTA net / Special (Karen) / Other
rate_per_night_vnd: Rate per room per night quoted or shown in email (number only). Blank if not stated
discount_promo: e.g. "Early Bird 5%; BNO stay 10 pay 9" or "Special 15%". Blank if none
surcharge: e.g. "+20% Indian guests", "Child 350k x 3 nights", "1-night 250k x 2 pax". Blank if none
total_vnd: Total for this row if stated in email
hold_until: For tentative holds: time limit date
prepaid: Yes (paid on OTA/to agency) / No (pay at hotel / agency invoice)
invoice_details: Red invoice/VAT company name, tax code, address, if given
special_requests: Guest requests: high floor, adjacent rooms, non-smoking, honeymoon…
notes: See NOTES RULE on Rules tab
missing_info: What the email didn't say (e.g. "room type; pax"). If not blank Tracy stops and asks
COD: 48 hours from when client receives booking confirmation
